item.title: Apple refreshes MacBook Pro lineup with M5 chips, starting at $1,599
item.description: The new 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pro models get Apple's M5 family of chips, Thunderbolt 5 across the board and a brighter display. They ship October 15.

item.title: AWS outage in US-EAST-1 knocks Slack, Venmo and Ring offline
item.description: A major Amazon Web Services outage centered on its US-EAST-1 region in northern Virginia is disrupting Slack, Venmo, Ring, Fortnite and many other apps.

item.title: AWS launches Graviton5 servers promising 40% better price performance
item.description: Amazon Web Services has made its Arm-based Graviton5 chips generally available in new EC2 instances, claiming 40% better price performance.

item.title: Crypto lending startup Nimbus and its CEO charged with fraud by the SEC
item.description: Nimbus, a venture-backed crypto lending startup, and its founder Mark Ellery were charged by the SEC over a $1.2 billion scheme involving its Yield Vault product.

item.title: Rivian opens its first fast-charging hub in Europe
item.description: Rivian's first Adventure Network site outside North America opens near Amsterdam with 24 chargers open to all electric vehicles.
